# Bigg Dogg — Listowel Street Eats

> Website concept for Bigg Dogg, a Listowel, Ontario food truck serving burgers, fish and chips, poutine, loaded fries, chicken tenders, sausages, hot dogs and other street eats.

## About
- Location: Canadian Tire parking lot, 500 Mitchell Road South, Listowel, Ontario
- Typical hours shown in the concept: Monday-Saturday, 11:00 AM-7:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Ordering shown in the concept: call or text 647-679-5006
- Social links: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/61550663527060/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/bigg_dogg2023/)

## Menu shown in the concept
- Original Smash Burger: $9.50; combo: $14.50
- Haddock Fish & Chips: $16.00
- Loaded Fries / Poutine: $10.50
- Chicken Tenders: $8.00; combo: $12.50
- Hot Dog: $7.00
- Chili Dog: $8.00
- Cajun, Polish or Oktoberfest sausage: $8.00
- Battered Mushrooms: $8.00
- Onion Rings: $8.50
- Loaded Nachos: $10.50
- Side gravy: $2.75
- Pop or water: $2.00
- Combo upgrade: +$5.00
